newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: AEGON TO COMPLETE PROVIDIAN DEAL IN SUMMER.
newsitem.headline: AEGON TO COMPLETE PROVIDIAN DEAL IN SUMMER.

text.p: Insurer Aegon NV said on Friday it expected to finalise the acquisition of the insurance activities of U.S. Providian Corp by June or July.

"We expect permissioning (from the relevant authorities) to be rounded off by the summer... with the transaction to be rounded off in June or July," Aegon chairman Kees Storm told a results news conference.
The $3.5 billion deal signed last December is subject to Federal government approval and the Securities and Exchange Commission, as well as insurance sector regulators in 10 American states.
The deal, based partly on a tax-free share swap, was also awaiting the outcome of an assessment by U.S. tax authorities.
Storm said the Providian takeover was expected to boost Aegon's earnings per share by around five percentage points on an annual basis.
"Obviously it will be less than that in 1997...if the acquisition is rounded off in July Providian will provide five twelfths of this," Storm said.
Aegon said earlier that excluding the Providian deal net earnings and earnings per share were expected to rise by 10-12 percent in guilder terms over 1997.
"The (approval) process is proceeding as expected," said Don Shepard, Aegon board member responsible for U.S. operations.
